about: A harvested cabbage head for Items/Food/Cabbage.et: a dense pale-green head about 18 cm across wrapped in a few darker, loosely cupped outer leaves with pale veins, a cut stalk underneath. Built by build.py in headless Blender (kitlib) with a procedural leaf texture. The vanilla CabbageCrop_01 is an 0.84 m field plant with no collider, so it cannot be a carried item; Meshy is reserved for fish and masks.

layout_m.about: Enfusion metres; origin at the bottom of the head (it rests on the stalk end), y up.
